assumptions.statement: All submitted geometry uses the repository provisional boundary; the official site boundary, key-area polygons, road redlines and park edge face are not yet publicly available.
assumptions.impact: Area, ratio and distance metrics are design-model outputs subject to recalculation when official data is published; they are not official redlines or precise-area bases.

assumptions.statement: The inferred green spine is a measurement baseline generated by this proposal for method demonstration; it is not claimed to be the actual Jing-Zhang Heritage Park alignment.
assumptions.impact: Near-side units, the three rings and all distance-dependent metrics must be recalculated along the official park edge face when available.

assumptions.statement: Building footprints, storey assumptions and building footprint coverage are conceptual low-confidence design quantities, not statutory building scale or development controls.
assumptions.impact: FAR, building height, building density and setbacks remain unknown pending official regulatory controls.

assumptions.statement: The OSM background cross-check is volunteer-contributed data with uneven coverage and precision.
assumptions.impact: Offset readings are used only to explain provisional-boundary uncertainty, not to replace or upgrade the official boundary.
